done.description: Create a modern, responsive Dark Mode Next.js dashboard using Tailwind CSS. The dashboard should include a sleek sidebar navigation with links to key sections such as 'Dashboard', 'Products', 'Leads', and 'Transactions'. Implement a top header with the company logo and user profile dropdown. Below the header, create a grid of 4 placeholder metric cards displaying dummy data (e.g., Total Leads, Active Transactions, Revenue Generated, etc.). Ensure all components are styled using Tailwind CSS for a clean and professional look.

Add the following line of code to the 'main.py' file as a fun easter egg: `import antigravity`. This should be added at an appropriate location in the codebase, ensuring it does not interfere with the main functionality.

Create a modern, responsive Dark Mode Next.js dashboard using Tailwind CSS. The dashboard should include a sleek sidebar navigation with links to different sections of the dashboard. Implement a top header with a brand logo and user profile icon. Design a grid layout containing 4 placeholder metric cards that display dummy data. Ensure the design is fully responsive and adapts to various screen sizes.
Add the following line of code as a fun easter egg in your Python script: 'import antigravity'. This should be added to the main.py file.
